texts.eyebrow: Pardubice city transport (DPMP) · afternoon peak · Simutrans reference
texts.lede: Every trolleybus and bus the DPMP afternoon peak needs at 16:00, line by line, on the network running on Tue 29 Sep 2026, with the vehicles logged on Fri 25 Sep 2026 (one real day). Each vehicle shows its number, depot, full type, length and custom pak128 object; each line has the values for the Simutrans fork’s schedule. The old sheet’s reference (battery sections, stops and their lines, termini, specials and closures) follows below the vehicles.
texts.network: All DPMP day lines with afternoon service in the timetable in force on Tue 29 Sep 2026 (CIS JŘ JDF, export of 28 Sep 2026: trolleybus lines from the city export, bus lines from the bus export). The table lists the trip patterns starting 15:00–17:59; for line 20, which ends at 14:43, 6:30–9:29, and for airport line 90, which runs only to the flight schedule and not on Tuesdays, the Monday 5 Oct trips 8:00–10:59 (as on the old sheet). “Leaves at” gives the minutes in the reference hour, 16:00–16:59. 29 Sep is a school day, so the school-day trips run. Depot runs are left out.
texts.network_after: Simutrans lines follow a rule (as on the Ostrava bus sheet): the terminus pair with the most trips is the line; another pair is a Simutrans line of its own when it has at least 6 trips in 15:00–17:59 (3 for a loop), a departure between 16:00 and 16:59 and no depot end. Everything else (the extensions of 3 to Lázně Bohdaneč, U Mlýnů, of 18 to Živanice and of 7 and 11 to Rybitví, the Mikulovice trip of 1, 4 to Globus before 15:30, the short workings) is merged into the line leaving the same terminus.
texts.schedule: Values to type into the fork’s Scheduling tab, on the stop entry each vehicle leaves from. Units are calendar minutes, Offset counts from midnight modulo the interval, and Leave up to stays automatic. Every DPMP terminus is a turning loop or turning point (točna), so every departure is set 1 min before the timetable: Offset and Also at are the real minute − 1, with the real minutes underneath. Branches are separate lines. Every entry reproduces the whole 16:00–16:59 hour: an exact repeating pattern where one exists, otherwise the hour’s own minutes repeated hourly (many DPMP afternoon timetables are irregular). An entry with at most 8 departures a day gets Departure every 1440 with all of them (exact all day).
texts.schedule_after: Vehicles needed at 16:00 = the timetable cycle (cycle_need): follow a vehicle leaving around 16:00 through its round trip, taking at each end the first departure at least 3 min after arriving, or sooner where the timetable itself turns faster; a round trip that would wait longer than 1.5 × the headway (at least 30 min) for its next trip is skipped. A DPMP line never gets fewer vehicles than the most of its trips on the road at once between 16:00 and 16:59 (each trip holding its vehicle until arrival plus the turnaround); the extra goes to its main line. Every Simutrans line gets at least 1 vehicle. Lines 20 and 90 are sized at their own reference time.
texts.lines: One row per vehicle, grouped by Simutrans line, trolleybus lines first. Kurz numbers are DPMP’s, written line/kurz. Each vehicle shows its number and depot, its full type, length and traction battery, and the pak128 core. The vehicles are the afternoon cars logged on Fri 25 Sep 2026 (tram-bus.cz via seznam-autobusu.cz): one real day, not a mix. Where a line was logged short, the missing vehicles are designed, not recorded: real cars from the line’s own history, active in the register and not out anywhere that day, covering every type of the line’s roster first. Where more were logged than needed, the surplus is not needed: dimmed at the bottom of the card and left out of every count, the depot and the pak totals.
texts.pak: Each type and livery at 16:00, mapped to the custom Czech pak128 packages VZ-DPPardubice-trolleybus and VZ-DPPardubice-bus. Object names are VZ-DPPardubice-<type>-<livery>-<core>; the vehicle lists show the core. A full advert wrap (CVR) keeps the type’s normal DPMP livery; plain white is a livery of its own. A requested object does not exist yet: it is listed in pipeline/pardubice/pak_request.md for the pak session, and no stand-in from another city is used.
texts.pak_after: Car units per object (16 = one tile). Every object is waytype road; the trolleybus objects are engine_type electric and need no wire in the game, so the battery sections are information only.
texts.depot: DPMP has one depot, Vozovna Dukla, for every trolleybus and bus (the register’s depot code Duk). Vehicles counted at 16:00, by Simutrans line.
texts.battery: Where DPMP trolleybuses leave the wire and run on traction batteries (kept from the old sheet; 18 and 27 inferred there). Battery cars are the 30 Tr 480–483 and the 32 Tr 460–469 and 476–497. Every Simutrans line that leaves the wire has only battery cars counted (checked by the pipeline).
texts.battery_after: Line 12 is licensed as a trolleybus line, and battery trolleybuses ran some of its Černá za Bory and Mnětice trips from 2018. Every weekday sampled in 2026 had buses only, apart from the evening line 2 trolleybuses that continue as 12 from Zámeček, so 12 is a bus line here. The rest of the network (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 13, 21, 33) runs under the wire, including the new wire to Lázně Bohdaneč, U Mlýnů and over the provisional Kapitána Bartoše bridge.
texts.stops: Every stop served by a modelled trip between 15:00 and 17:59 (line 20: 6:30–9:29; line 90: Monday 8:00–10:59), with the trips towards each destination in those three hours (divide by 3 for trips an hour). Depot runs are left out.
texts.termini: Stops where trips start between 15:00 and 17:59 (line 20: 6:30–9:29; line 90: Monday 8:00–10:59), busiest first, with every departure by line and the number of trips that end there.
texts.specials: Through-running, guaranteed connections, express trips, long-term closures (modelled as they run) and short-term closures (ignored: the regular state is modelled). Kept from the old sheet of 26 Sep 2026.
method: Which day. Network: the timetable in force on Tue 29 Sep 2026. Vehicles: Fri 25 Sep 2026, the last weekday before it with records (28 Sep was a holiday); one real day. The old sheet used Tue 6 Oct for the network because line 29 changes on 1 Oct; 29 is a school line and left out, so the modelled lines are the same.

Vehicles. seznam-autobusu.cz vypravenost “MHD Pardubice” (data from tram-bus.cz) for Fri 25 Sep 2026: 104 records, 96 kurzy. ráno marks a morning duty, odpoledne the afternoon car of a split duty, nahrazen / náhrada za a car replaced during the day. Lines 16, 18, 22, 33, 88 and 90 have no weekday record on the day. Line histories since 1 Sep 2026 (and the latest records for lines with none) give the designed cars; the day overview checks that a designed car was not out that day.

Types, paint and depot. The DPMP register on seznam-autobusu.cz (DP města Pardubic, iddopravce 47, read 29 Sep 2026), matched by the site’s car id. Traction batteries from the old sheet (trolejbus.cz fleet list of 18 Mar 2026).

Timetable. CIS JŘ JDF 1.10, export of 28 Sep 2026 (the copies downloaded by the Ostrava pipelines; DPMP’s inner files are kept in pipeline/pardubice/data/raw/jdf). Version rule: among a line’s versions valid on the day, the latest “valid from” wins. DPMP marks its school-holiday trips with “runs in” date ranges; they do not run on 29 Sep.
Simutrans schedule. The shared rule (pipeline/README.md) with the Brno bus sheet’s requirement that every entry reproduces the 16:00 hour; all termini −1 min.

Earlier user decisions kept. Airport line 90 included; night lines 98 and 99, school line 29, the Škola Svítání service 910 and the cancelled bridge lines 902 and 906 left out; line 20 (ends 14:43) and line 90 modelled on their own times; long-term closures modelled as they run (the provisional Kapitána Bartoše bridge, line 13’s detour, the Tuněchody works), short-term ones ignored; no accessibility data.
Rebuild. Generated by pipeline/pardubice (state “2026-09-29”); the README there lists every decision and how to update the sheet.
